subject: Demo request: Redwood for BlueHarbor product search
messages:
From: Sophie Blake <sophie@blueharborretail.com>
To: Redwood Demo <demo@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo request and context (BlueHarbor Retail)

Hi team,

I signed up through self-serve and would love a short demo focused on using Redwood for product search ranking and reranking on our storefront. A couple quick data points to help prioritize: 
- Catalog size: ~10k SKUs
- Typical searches: ~1.8M/month
- Peak QPS (search traffic): ~120 QPS during promotions
- Primary goals: improve relevance, reduce null results, faster iteration on ranking tests

I'm hoping to run a pilot in early November and aim for a production rollout in H1 2027. I've attached a brief requirements doc (BH_requirements.pdf).

Could someone share availability for a 30-minute demo next week? Thanks — happy to provide more context ahead of time.

Best,
Sophie Blake
Head of Search & Personalization
BlueHarbor Retail
(Attachment: BH_requirements.pdf)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Blake <sophie@blueharborretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T13:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request and context (BlueHarbor Retail)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the context and the doc, this is perfect. I'm Rachel (SDR) on the Redwood team — happy to get a focused session scheduled. A couple quick clarifying questions so we tailor the run-through: 

1) Use case specifics: Is the primary flow live search ranking, or would you also like to cover offline re-ranking / personalization experiments?
2) Volume detail: you mentioned ~1.8M/month and 120 QPS peak — does that peak represent short promo bursts (minutes) or sustained windows (hours)?
3) Data access & privacy: will you be sharing search logs and product metadata for the pilot (yes/no)? Any data residency constraints?
4) Timeline: pilot kickoff in early Nov — is that a tight date or are you flexible into Nov/Dec?

If helpful, please fill this 2-minute intake form so we capture the environment and samples: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/redwood-intake-form

Proposed 30-minute slots next week (PT):
• Tue 9/15 10:00–10:30
• Wed 9/16 14:00–14:30
• Thu 9/17 09:00–09:30

I cc'd Aditya (solutions engineer) — he'll join to discuss architecture and integration specifics if the pilot looks likely.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Sales Development
Redwood Inference
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/rachel-kim
From: Sophie Blake <sophie@blueharborretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request and context (BlueHarbor Retail)

Thanks Rachel — quick answers below and I've attached a small sample of anonymized search logs.

1) Primary flow: live search ranking + reranking. We also run A/B experiments for ranking tweaks, so a brief mention of experiment workflows would be helpful.
2) Peak pattern: mostly short promo bursts (10–30 minutes) but we do see sustained higher traffic on Black Friday windows (hours).
3) Data access: we can share anonymized logs and product metadata for the pilot. No special residency constraints — US-based.
4) Timeline: early November pilot kickoff is our target, but we have some flexibility into mid-November depending on integration timing.

Preferred slot: Thu 9/17 09:00–09:30 PT works best for our team.

Attachments: search_sample.csv

Looking forward to the demo.

—Sophie
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Blake <sophie@blueharborretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request and context (BlueHarbor Retail)

Perfect — thanks for the quick answers and the sample. I've scheduled the 30-minute session: Thu, Sep 17, 09:00–09:30 PT. Calendar invite (Google) has been sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=xyz123-blueharbor-demo

Agenda (short):
• 5 min intros + goal alignment
• 10 min demo: search & reranking flow, ingestion options
• 10 min integration + pilot architecture (Aditya)
• 5 min next steps / mutual action plan

Aditya — feel free to review Sophie's sample ahead of the call; we might cover expected throughput and KV cache strategies.

(If anything changes on your side, Sophie, let me know and we can reschedule.)

Thanks —
Rachel
From: Sophie Blake <sophie@blueharborretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks,
Sophie
